config.prompt: Aapke profile par ek loan overdue dikh raha hai jiska total amount ₹2000 hai, aur ye 5 dino se overdue chal raha hai. Aap call par rehte hue hi UPI ke through abhi payment complete kar dijiye, taaki hum turant aapki help kar sakein aur payment se related koi bhi dikkat na ho. Saath hi aapka profile bhi turant update ho jayega. Kya aap abhi payment karenge?
config.responseDirective: State the overdue amount and overdue days, ask for payment now through UPI, and mention immediate profile update. Use the caller current language.

config.prompt: Ek achhi baat bata dun — agar aap abhi call par payment complete karte hain, toh aapki credit limit gradually ₹50,000 tak badhne ke high chances hain. BHIM UPI se payment par ₹40 tak ka discount mil sakta hai, aur Paytm UPI se ₹10 se ₹300 tak ka cashback aur mahine mein ek baar ₹2,000 tak ka Paytm voucher milne ka chance bhi hai. Toh kya aap abhi UPI se payment complete karenge?
config.responseDirective: Explain every approved credit-limit, BHIM and Paytm benefit with all amounts, then ask whether the caller can pay now. Use the caller current language.

config.prompt: System records ke hisaab se, pehle bhi aapko calls kiye gaye hain jinme payment ke baare mein baat hui thi — jaise ki aapne promise kiya tha ki aap payment kar denge. Lekin dekh kar afsos ho raha hai ki abhi tak payment receive nahi hui. Aapne bina kisi extra charges ke kaafi baar loan time par repay kiya hai. Isi tarah abhi bhi payment kariye, taaki koi extra penalty ya charges add na hon. Kya aap abhi payment karenge?
config.responseDirective: Explain the previous missed promise and positive repayment history without inventing details, then ask for payment now. Use the caller current language.

config.prompt: Aap business, job ya study karte hain — toh aapke paas savings toh hogi hi. Usme se loan ka repayment kar dijiye. Ya aap kisi friend ya family se arrange karke bhi pay kar sakte hain, isse aapko koi penalty bhi nahi deni hogi. Kya aap payment ka intezaam kar lenge?
config.responseDirective: Explain the approved savings or friends-and-family arrangement option respectfully, then ask whether funds can be arranged. Use the caller current language.

config.prompt: Main aapko inform karna chahti hun ki due date par payment na karne se penalty daily badhti hai aur extra charges lagte rehte hain. Extra charges avoid karne ke liye abhi payment complete kar dijiye. Kya aap abhi payment karenge?
config.responseDirective: Explain that daily penalty and extra charges increase, then ask for payment now. Use the caller current language.

config.prompt: Ek aur zaroori baat — time par repayment na karne se aapka CIBIL score impact hota hai, aur aaj ke time mein CIBIL bahut important hai. Emergency mein — jaise medical ya family needs — loan ki zarurat kabhi bhi pad sakti hai. Agar CIBIL low hoga toh loan milne mein dikkat ho sakti hai, ya interest rate kaafi high ho sakta hai. Isliye request hai ki abhi payment complete kar dijiye aur apna CIBIL safe rakhiye. Kya aap payment karenge?
config.responseDirective: Explain the approved CIBIL and emergency-loan consequences without threats, then ask for payment. Use the caller current language.

config.text: Theek hai, main aapki baat note kar rahi hun. Kripya yaad rakhiye — jitni jaldi aap payment complete karenge, utna hi aap extra penalty aur CIBIL impact se bachenge. Kripya aaj hi एमपॉकेट app se apna payment complete karne ki koshish kijiye. एमपॉकेट mein samay dene ke liye dhanyavaad, aapka din shubh ho!
config.responseDirective: Close respectfully after the final refusal, mentioning penalty/CIBIL consequences once and the app payment option. Use the caller current language.

config.question: Bahut achha! Kya aap apna poora overdue amount pay karenge, ya partial payment karenge?
config.responseDirective: Ask whether the caller will make full or partial payment. Use the caller current language and preserve both options.

config.question: Kaunse madhyam se aapka payment hoga – Debit Card ya UPI?
config.responseDirective: Ask whether payment will be through Debit Card or UPI. Use the caller current language and preserve both options.

config.text: Dhanyavaad! Kripya एमपॉकेट app kholkar apna payment abhi complete kar dijiye. BHIM UPI ya Paytm UPI se payment karne par discount ya cashback milne ke chances bhi hain. Payment complete hote hi aapka profile turant update ho jayega aur koi extra penalty charges nahi lagenge.
config.responseDirective: Guide the caller to pay safely in the एमपॉकेट app, mention applicable UPI benefits and profile update, and never claim payment completed. Use the caller current language.

config.text: एमपॉकेट mein samay dene ke liye dhanyavaad, aapka din shubh ho!
config.responseDirective: Thank the caller and close politely in the caller current language.

config.text: Koi baat nahi, hum aapko baad mein call kar lenge. Kripya jitni jaldi ho sake एमपॉकेट app se apna payment complete kar dijiye, taaki koi extra charges na lagen. Dhanyavaad, aapka din shubh ho!
config.responseDirective: Confirm the callback and close politely without repeating the full pitch. Use the caller current language.

config.text: Maaf kijiye, lagta hai yeh call galat number par lag gayi. Aapka samay lene ke liye khed hai. Dhanyavaad, aapka din shubh ho!
config.responseDirective: Apologize for the wrong person or number, reveal no loan details, and close in the caller current language.

config.text: Agar aapne payment already complete kar di hai, toh dhanyavaad! Main aapko hamare agent se connect kar rahi hun jo aapki payment verify kar denge. Kripya line par bane rahiye.
config.responseDirective: Acknowledge the already-paid claim without treating it as verified, and say an agent will verify it. Use the caller current language.

config.text: Main aapko hamare ek agent se connect kar rahi hun. Kripya line par bane rahiye.
config.responseDirective: Tell the caller they are being connected to an agent. Use the caller current language.

config.prompt: Main aapki baat samajh rahi hun. Aapki financial ya family situation ke liye mujhe afsos hai. Main abhi payment ke liye aap par pressure nahi daalungi. Kya aap chahenge ki hum baad mein baat karein, ya main aapko support agent se connect karun?
config.responseDirective: Acknowledge financial or medical hardship empathetically without pressure, then offer either a later callback or a support agent. Use the caller current language.

config.text: Theek hai, main samajh gayi hun. Aap pehle apni zaroori needs ka dhyan rakhiye. Jab aapke liye possible ho, एमपॉकेट app mein repayment options check kar sakte hain. Dhanyavaad, aapka din shubh ho.
config.responseDirective: Close respectfully after hardship and do not pressure the caller. Use the caller current language.
